name: One Million Screenshots

sources.title: Homepage — zoomable grid of ~1M homepage screenshots
Suggest a Site — enter your email and the site you'd like to see added
FAQ — 'Can I add my website? Not yet. But we might expand in future months'; suggestion box offered
API docs — free homepage-screenshot API requiring attribution link back
FlowingData coverage — sites chosen by rank in the Common Crawl web graph; screenshots retaken monthly

conditions: There is no guaranteed inclusion path — sites are chosen by rank in the Common Crawl web graph
The only self-serve route is the 'Suggest a Site' form at /add (email + site URL), which is explicitly a suggestion, not a listing guarantee
FAQ states 'Can I add my website? Not yet' — suggestions may be acted on in future monthly crawls
requirements: A public homepage that can be screenshotted
High enough web-graph rank (Common Crawl) to be included organically, or acceptance of a manual suggestion
An e-mail address for the suggestion form
preparation: Your site's URL and a contact e-mail
Ensure the homepage renders a meaningful screenshot without login or heavy JS gating
Improve general web presence/Common Crawl rank — inclusion is rank-driven
workflow: Check whether your site is already in the grid via the homepage search (⌘K)
Enter your e-mail and the site URL and submit the suggestion
Wait — the FAQ suggests checking back monthly; screenshots are refreshed on the first of each month
watchFor: This is not a conventional directory — there is no paid listing tier and no guaranteed acceptance
The suggestion form does not promise inclusion; FAQ explicitly says additions are not open yet
Only homepages are captured — no deep pages or custom screenshots
If you use their screenshot API elsewhere, attribution link-back at >=12pt legible font is required (separate product)
countsAsLive: Your homepage appears as a tile in the zoomable grid at onemillionscreenshots.com and is findable via site search
unknowns: Whether suggestions are reviewed manually or just folded into the next Common Crawl-ranked capture
Any minimum rank threshold for inclusion
Whether suggested sites get a confirmation e-mail when added
